messages.content:
You are grading an AI assistant's answer to a question about a company handbook.

Question: What hire date makes a GitLab team member eligible to participate in the equity refresh program?
Reference answer (written from the handbook): A hire date on or before October 5th makes a team member eligible to participate in the equity refresh program.

Passages the assistant was given:
"""
[Annual Compensation Review Cycle > Introduction > Annual Compensation Review > Eligibility]
Eligible team members for Annual Compensation Review have a hire date on or before:

- January 31st to be eligible to participate in the merit review program
- October 5th to be eligible to participate in the equity refresh program

Team members on leave will be eligible to receive an annual compensation and/or promotion increase during the GitLab-paid portion of their leave. If a team member is not receiving pay from GitLab, then they'll be eligible to receive the increase when they return to work.

Additionally, Team Members who receive a promotion as part of the FY26 Promotion Cycle will be eligible for the Annual Compensation Review process (including merit and equity).

Eligibility for review does not guarantee an increase will be awarded. Awards are recommended in alignment with team members’ contributions to the organization (as assessed during Talent Assessment) as is aligned to our pay-for-performance philosophy.

[Equity Compensation > About Your Ownership in GitLab > Annual Refresh Grant Program Eligibility]
Team members may be eligible to participate in the annual refresh grant cycle review if they have completed six months of service with the company. However, participation will be based upon individual team member talent assessments (including if a team member is currently in good standing) and [key talent criteria](/handbook/people-group/talent-assessment#key-talent-criteria). Therefore, not all team members will receive a refresh grant in the annual review cycle. Leaders will have discretion on the size of the refresh grant based on talent assessments and equity budget as allocated to each E-group member's division. All proposed grants will be reviewed by the People team for pay equality. All proposed equity grants are subject to review and approval by the GitLab Board of Directors.

[Equity Compensation > About Your Ownership in GitLab > Refresh Grants]
As part of the updated [Annual Compensation Review process](/handbook/total-rewards/compensation/compensation-review-cycle/#annual-compensation-review), eligible GitLab team members will be reviewed for a refresh grant once per year. Refresh grants use the formula above to determine the range of equity dollar value a team member may be eligible for in that cycle based on their current role/grade. Refresh grants will vest in accordance with the equity plan agreement between GitLab and the team members.

Note: All equity grants are subject to approval by the Board of Directors and no grants are final until such approval has been obtained. The company reserves the right in its sole discretion to make any adjustments to equity grants including the decision not to make a grant at all.
"""

Assistant's answer:
"""
A GitLab team member must have a hire date on or before October 5th to be eligible to participate in the equity refresh program [1].
"""

First write one sentence of reasoning, then grade three things:
- correctness: "correct" if the answer states the key information in the reference answer without contradicting it (extra correct detail is fine); "partial" if it gets part of it or is vague; "incorrect" if it is wrong, contradicts the reference, or does not answer.
- refused: true if the assistant declined or said it does not know, instead of answering.
- faithful: true if every factual claim in the answer is supported by the passages above (ignore whether it matches the reference). An answer that only refuses counts as faithful.
The grades must agree with your reasoning.
Return JSON with the reasoning first: {"reason": "one sentence", "correctness": "correct" | "partial" | "incorrect", "refused": true/false, "faithful": true/false}
